title: A reader writes: Revolutionary – can’t wait

body:
A reader writes:

 I’m a pastor who attended an event with you recently.  I announced an opportunity to read “The Great Spiritual Migration” at the church I serve, and a group of 10 formed for the first meeting!  A very animated, excited conversation ensued, and we only covered the Preface and Introduction in two hours .  The reading of the 2nd chapter sparked two emails from two readers, saying they had just read something that for them was “revolutionary,” and they could hardly wait for our Friday morning meeting.

 Thanks for that encouragement. I’m hearing so many encouraging reports like this. This seems like a critical time to help people find a way to deepen and activate their faith.
